applicabilityBasis.summary: BD is a transferable dollar-targeted token minted by borrowing against ETH, liquid staking tokens, cbBTC and Aero LP collateral through permissionless Base contracts. Holders can redeem BD for dollar-valued collateral at face value, but public materials identify no legal person obligated to redeem BD for a fixed amount of US dollars or bank-deposit monetary value under GENIUS section 2(22). Stablecoin-shaped payment use with an unresolved issuer redemption obligation keeps applicability genuinely unclear.

genius.notes: Reviewed 2026-10-28. No legal issuer of BD is identified in official materials. The launch post credits Base Dollar contributors, states the protocol is a licensed Liquity V2 friendly fork on Base, and disclaims affiliation with Coinbase or Base. Governance scope is limited to revenue routing, fee limits, collateral debt limits and adding branches, and no entity accepts a redemption obligation in national currency. No issuerEntity is recorded because no exact legal entity is evidenced. Redemption returns collateral value, not currency or bank-deposit monetary value.

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: As of 2026-10-28, the Federal Register search, official issuer domains and token-specific web searches found no GENIUS permitted payment stablecoin issuer approval, state qualification, official application or foreign-issuer registration for Base Dollar or BD. The token has no identified legal issuer to hold such a status. This is a bounded public-evidence finding, not proof that no unpublished filing exists.
